summary: Make the app colorful and fun: five color themes picked from a Colors menu in the sidebar, a drifting aurora background, a color per page in the sidebar, cards that lift and glow, flowing gradient buttons and progress bars, pages that rise in, popping messages and dialogs, and confetti when a post goes out, gets scheduled or a profile goes live. Animations can be turned off and respect the system's reduced-motion setting.

spots.note: themes, aurora, hover/enter/progress/notice/dialog animations, calm mode
theme + motion storage, isCelebration, celebrate confetti
imports fun.css, applies the saved look before render
ThemePicker in the sidebar; confetti for celebratory success messages
